name: ReactWoo Atomic
author: reactwoo

sections.description:
ReactWoo Atomic adds native Elementor 4.1+ Atomic widgets (Editor V4). Turn on Atomic Widgets / Editor V4 under Elementor → Settings → Features.

Every widget in this plugin is fully available. There is no licence key, no trial, and no locked control. Atomic Pro is a separate plugin for people who want additional elements.

Included elements:

  • Carousel
  • Off-canvas drawer
  • Modal
  • Content switcher
  • Smart menu
  • Scroll navigation
  • Multi-step form
  • Before / after
  • Comparison table
  • Hotspots
  • Timeline
  • Marquee
  • Progress

Widgets render on the server, load their CSS and JavaScript only when they are on the page, and aim for WCAG 2.2 AA (keyboard use, visible focus, names, and reduced motion).

Elementor is a trademark of Elementor Ltd. ReactWoo Atomic is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor.

This plugin does not connect to any external service. WordPress.org provides its updates.

Optional links to Atomic Pro open https://reactwoo.com/atomic/compare/ only when you click them.

  • Terms of use: https://reactwoo.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://reactwoo.com/privacy/

External services

ReactWoo Atomic does not collect telemetry.

This plugin does not connect to any external service. WordPress.org provides its updates.

Links to Atomic Pro (https://reactwoo.com/atomic/compare/) open only when you click them.

  • Terms of use: https://reactwoo.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://reactwoo.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor 4.1 or newer.
  2. In Elementor → Settings → Features, enable Atomic Widgets (Editor V4).
  3. Upload this plugin and activate it, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and insert a ReactWoo Atomic widget. You can also enable or disable widgets under ReactWoo Atomic → Elements.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Atomic Pro or a licence?

No. Every element shipped in ReactWoo Atomic works without Atomic Pro and without an account. Atomic Pro is a separate plugin.

Does the plugin send telemetry or connect to ReactWoo?

It does not collect telemetry. This plugin does not connect to any external service. WordPress.org provides its updates. Links to reactwoo.com run only when you click them.

Terms of use: https://reactwoo.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://reactwoo.com/privacy/

What does “Remove data on uninstall” do?

It is off by default. When it is on, deleting the plugin removes ReactWoo Atomic options. Form entries are personal data and are removed with WordPress’ export/erase tools. Options are kept if ReactWoo Atomic Pro is still installed.
sections.changelog:
0.8.9

  • Smart Menu: the mobile button can have its own screen-reader name. A hamburger icon is not used as that name, and a second click closes the menu.

0.8.8

  • Inline scripts encode JSON so a value cannot close the script tag.
  • Admin saves and the public form route check a nonce, and privileged actions check the user’s capability.
  • The Atomic Pro add-on notice stays on ReactWoo Atomic screens. Dismissing an admin notice is remembered.

0.8.7

  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.8.7.

0.8.6

  • Remaining public identifiers now use the reactwoo_atomic prefix.
  • Existing form entries and saved editor payloads are updated on upgrade.

0.8.5

  • Public PHP identifiers use the reactwoo_atomic prefix. Settings saved by earlier versions are kept.
  • The WordPress.org package does not include a licence-key screen. The ReactWoo download is unchanged.

0.8.4

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.
  • Reduced-motion styles are added with wp_add_inline_style.
  • The unused analytics checkbox was removed. This plugin does not send telemetry.
  • Deleting the plugin can remove its options when that setting is on.
  • The WordPress.org package does not include a custom updater. The ReactWoo download is unchanged.

0.8.3

  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.8.3.

0.8.2

  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.8.2.

0.8.1

  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.8.1.

0.8.0

  • Plugin homepage and upgrade links now open https://reactwoo.com/atomic/ and https://reactwoo.com/atomic/compare/ (the old addresses returned 404).
  • Integrations screen: the Geo Core link now opens https://reactwoo.com/geo-core/ (it pointed at a page that no longer exists).
  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.8.0.

0.7.5

  • Multi-step Form chips: new single-select option (“select”: “single”) with radio-group semantics, arrow-key navigation and one answer.
  • Multi-step Form prefill (e.g. ?goal=): when the prefilled answer completes step 1 the form moves on to step 2. Focus is not moved on page load; the step change is announced.
  • Editor: the Multi-step Form card no longer shows an empty 100px drop zone below the form on the canvas.

0.7.4

  • Maintenance release aligned with Atomic Pro 0.7.4. No changes to Free features.

0.7.3

  • Multi-step Form (beta): one question per step with option cards, progress and Back, per-step and server validation, REST submit with nonce, spam guard (honeypot, minimum time, rate limit), private entries with privacy export/erase, and admin email. Matches Figma Widget 04.
  • Widget styles overhaul for Editor V4: default selectors use :where() and print after Elementor’s base styles, so V4 global classes and local styles override them; most !important flags removed.
  • Editor safeguard: if Elementor’s store loses the document’s global-class styles after the preview loads, they are reloaded (one delayed check, max 3 tries).
  • Smart Menu: the mobile menu shows again when opened (closed-state rule now only matches while closed).

0.7.2

  • Defer carousel global-class creation until after WooCommerce init so kit writes do not trigger wc_get_product too early.

0.7.1

  • Keep Elementor widgets-config cheap: no kit writes on editor AJAX, bounded editor options, no widgets-config workarounds.

0.7.0

  • Foundation recovery for Elementor 4.1.5+ / 4.2 Editor V4 (Atomic base loading + opt-in detection).
  • Modal Stage 2, Off-Canvas / Carousel editor canvas bridges, Content Switcher beta.

0.5.3

  • Admin dashboard polish: settings-driven assets/a11y, Elements UI, Integrations badge accuracy.

0.5.2

  • Maintenance release aligned with Pro AI Concierge ability runner.

0.5.1

  • Maintenance release aligned with Pro commerce cart widgets.

0.5.0

  • Admin console: Overview, Elements manager, Licence, Integrations, Settings.

0.4.1

  • Maintenance release aligned with Pro license/query work.

0.4.0

  • Packaging hardened so Free builds exclude Pro-only packages and assets.

0.3.0

  • Full Free widget catalogue (12 widgets).

0.2.0

  • Off-Canvas / Drawer widget.

0.1.0

  • Milestone 0 scaffold.
